message: Mostly good, one layering concern inline.

lustre/lov/lov_io.c.message: (style) This isn't a functional bug, but the new contention path makes the lower LOV layer directly unlock and drop a VFS page-cache page. Client layering reserves `struct page` lifetime/locking operations for llite/VVP; could this retry cleanup be routed through a CLIO/VVP operation instead?
